models.name: EmbeddingGemma-2
models.description: A variant of EmbeddingGemma 2 ready for deployment on Android using MediaPipe [UniversalEmbedder](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/retrieval/universal_embedder) and [SemanticRetriever](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/retrieval/semantic_retriever). It is a multimodal embedding model with image, audio, video, and text understanding.
